meta._doc: Scout smoke-test run for the 2026 World Cup forecast. Bounded: 1 BGM (audio) + 1 official-anthem embed + 1 high-value player photo + 1 live-status record. Detective already covered trophy, 3 venues, and 8 nation flags, so Scout adds music, freshness, and a human emotional anchor (Messi) it did not have.

sct_04.label: Player ratings & portraits — credits & licences
sct_04.claim: The player ability cards are EA Sports FC ratings (FC 26 base cards; Toni Kroos FC 24), reproduced for commentary/comparison and cited to EA Sports — not hand-set by us and not affiliated with or endorsed by EA Sports or FIFA; per-card source links are in each card's 'Sources'. Portraits in this build are official player portraits used for the LOCAL build only and are publish-gated: they must be swapped to the Wikimedia Commons photos (attributed per each licence) before any public release. The team deep-run and champion odds shown beside the cards come from this project's Elo-Poisson-Monte-Carlo model.

live_status.subject: 2026 World Cup group-stage results and group leaders (matchdays 1-2, into early matchday 3)
live_status.status: Group stage underway across USA/Canada/Mexico. Mexico clinched Group A (1-0 over South Korea, 18 Jun); USA clinched Group D (4-1 Paraguay 12 Jun, 2-0 Australia 19 Jun); Canada thrashed Qatar 6-0 and Switzerland beat Bosnia 4-1 (both 18 Jun); Brazil 3-0 Haiti (19 Jun) with Morocco topping Group C; Germany 7-1 Curacao and Netherlands 2-2 Japan (14 Jun). Display-only freshness context as of 2026-06-21; NOT a model input.
